sentences.text:
With

With

The National Insurance Co. Ltd.
 Vs.
 Namita Maji & Ors.
 Mr. Sanjay Paul
 Ms. Jaita Ghosh
 ... for the appellant/Insurance Company
In Re: Can 1 of 2023

The learned advocate for the
 appellant/insurance company is present.
Despite service of notice, none appeared for  the respondents.

The learned Registrar Administration (L & OM) is to serve notice upon the respondents/claimants intimating the next date of hearing through the concerned police station and file a compliance report to that effect on the returnable date.
The application being CAN 1 of 2023 under Section 5 of the limitation Act has been taken up for hearing.
From the record it reveals that there is a delay of 65 days.

Considering the averments made in Paragraph 6 to 10 of the CAN application being 1 of 2023 and in view of the beneficial legislative intent the delay of 65 days in filing the instant appeal is condoned.
The application being CAN 1 of 2023 is allowed.
The Department is directed to register the appeal.

sentences.text: In Re: CAN 2 of 2023

As per the order of this Court dated 20.12.2023 the Insurance Company had deposited the entire awarded compensation before the office of the learned Registrar General, High Court at Calcutta vide OD Challan No. 3395 dated 15.01.2024.
Let the said challan be kept on record.
Accordingly, the interim order of stay dated 20th December, 2023 is made absolute and the stay shall continue till the disposal of the instant appeal.
The application being CAN 2 of 2023 is disposed of.
The informal paper book be filed on the next date of hearing.
Let the matter be fixed on 6th January, 2025.
(Ananya Bandyopadhyay, J.)
